scenes.audio_narration: Key features include: TypeScript Refactoring, React/Vue/Angular Directives, Built-in Test Runner, Git & HTTP Client.

scenes.google_flow_prompt: High quality graphical breakdown card displaying Pros vs Cons for WebStorm.
scenes.audio_narration: On the pros side: Best-in-class JavaScript, TypeScript, and JSX refactoring, Auto-importing and real-time type checking without delay, Integrated testing tools for Jest, Vitest, and Cypress, Out-of-the-box support for modern JS frameworks. On the cons side: Higher memory consumption than lightweight web editors, Commercial license required for paid corporate projects, Slight initial load times.
